interface.name: polly_appearance_v1

description.summary: separate trusted appearance publisher and renderer

interface.description: This private global is restricted to compositor-owned Shell and decorator connections. The Shell publishes themes but cannot render. The decorator renders but can publish only the first theme, before a Shell transaction. Version 7 requires the separately supervised GUI service, geometry schema 7 and effects ABI 3. Regional backdrop is a separately queried capability. The optional native radius is numeric geometry, not a style identifier. Earlier private versions are deliberately rejected. Render requests expose caption geometry and text, never client content or input injection. Version 8 optionally pairs regional taskbar and Start recipients. Version 7 and its Dock material keep their original meaning.

entry.name: unauthorized
entry.summary: connection does not own this role

request.name: prepare

description.summary: validate a runtime decoration snapshot without applying it

request.description: Configuration contains schema 7, left-controls (0 or 1), and the geometry-only metrics specified by appearance-fields.h. Colors, fonts, glyphs, materials and style selection are interpreted only by the GUI. Shadow color is premultiplied only at composition; RGB, active/inactive opacity percentages, sigma and biased offsets are bounded numeric data. Unsupported data is rejected through prepared; the Shell keeps the last committed appearance visible. Name is a bounded identifier. Document is a readable, immutable memfd sealed against writes, growth, shrinkage and further seal changes. Its exact size is 1-32768 bytes. Data is owned and validated by the Shell; the compositor does not parse JSON. Passing an FD avoids the connection's small individual-message limit. Only one staged snapshot is kept per resource. Invalid configuration is rejected through prepared, not a fatal protocol error.

request.name: cancel
request.description: Cancellation is idempotent; it never changes the committed appearance.

request.name: submit_frame

description.summary: submit one complete immutable four-strip snapshot

request.description: Metadata and exact dimensions, strides, offsets and size are defined by decoration-frame.h. All strips are supplied in one sealed memfd; there is no partial update. Token, revision, generation, geometry, scale and state must match the latest render request. Old requests are harmlessly rejected. The renderer never receives the application's content.

event.name: frame_result
event.description: Invalid submissions do not alter the currently presented snapshot.

description.summary: discard queued requests for an unmapped, closed or unavailable frame

event.name: renderer_status

description.summary: service health and advisory bootstrap eligibility

event.description: State is 0 disabled, 1 starting or recovering, 2 ready, or 3 failed. Bootstrap eligibility is advisory, is sent only to the decorator, and is checked again on prepare and commit. Any successful theme commit consumes it for the lifetime of this compositor, including reconnects. A Shell prepare takes priority over a staged bootstrap.

description.summary: 1 only for a real supported regional renderer, otherwise 0

request.name: prepare_backdrop

description.summary: stage an owned mapped Dock underlay in the prepared theme transaction

request.description: Shell publisher only, on its inherited authenticated connection. Surface must be its current mapped fixed-size bottom-anchored top layer, with rectangular input and no keyboard grab. No title/namespace authorization. Configuration is six uint words: schema 2, role 1 (Dock), radius in thousandths of a logical pixel (0-64000), sigma 1-32, RGB 0-16777215, tint opacity 0-100 percent. The entire actual surface is the footprint; no pixel readback is exposed. Geometry, surface commit sequence, owner and theme generation are rechecked on commit. Failure retains all previously committed layers and appearance. Candidate resources and kernel workspace share the effects scene-wide peak budget.

event.name: backdrop_status

description.summary: live regional output failure or recovery

event.description: Nonempty message means output composition failed: the last committed frame is retained, never an alpha/solid replacement. Retry requires new scene damage. Empty message reports recovery. Only the current Shell owner of a mapped regional layer on that output receives this event.

description.summary: 1 only for implemented Shell recipients and a supported regional renderer

request.name: prepare_shell_backdrop

description.summary: stage a real paired taskbar or Start recipient

request.description: Authenticated Shell publisher only. Configuration is six uint words: schema 3, role 2 (taskbar) or 3 (Start), radius in thousandths of a logical pixel, sigma, RGB and tint opacity with the v7 numeric bounds. Taskbar role requires surface == taskbar: top layer, bottom/left/right anchors, stretched width, positive height, no keyboard grab, exclusive zone equal to actual height, zero margins and actual full output width. Start requires a distinct surface on that same actual output: overlay, bottom-only anchor, fixed positive dimensions, exclusive zone -1, exclusive keyboard focus, zero top/left/right margins and nonnegative bottom margin. Its actual footprint fits above the paired taskbar. Both surfaces must be mapped, presented and have matching current buffer dimensions. No namespace, title or claimed application role is authority. Both sequences and boxes are rechecked on commit, along with the privacy epoch and generation. Each output has at most one taskbar, and a snapshot has at most one Start, whose taskbar must also be in that snapshot. The original total of eight targets and scene-wide peak budget apply. backdrop_prepared acknowledges this request. Failure preserves the last commit. Unmap, destroy or invalid actual geometry revokes the recipient; losing a paired taskbar also revokes Start, never other valid taskbars. shell_backdrop_retired identifies the committed serial and role so a delayed notification cannot alter a subsequently committed recipient.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: appearance serial that installed this recipient

arg.name: target
arg.summary: zero-based target ordinal in that complete appearance transaction

interface.name: polly_theme_manager_v1

description.summary: read-only appearance subscription for opt-in applications

interface.description: Public clients may observe the bounded theme document published by the trusted Shell. This interface grants no management or file access. Changes coalesce until the client requests the latest snapshot. Revisions are opaque uint identifiers, not timestamps.

entry.name: unexpected_request
entry.summary: snapshot requested without a change notification

request.name: get_snapshot
request.description: Exactly one request is allowed after changed. The snapshot may be newer than that notification. The unavailable event means that the Shell has not published a runtime theme.
